svg.title: Data preparation and research project delivery
svg.desc: 1. Approve and plan. Objectives, procedures, roles, budget, timeline and permissions.. 2. Collect and verify. Use a codebook, source checks, unique IDs and approved versions.. 3. Compile and analyze. Correct variable types, missing-data rules, denominators and justified tests.. 4. Interpret with safeguards. Check uncertainty, assumptions, deviations and alternative explanations.. 5. Communicate and close. Report findings, limitations, implications and governed retention.

g.text: Data preparation and research project delivery
A traceable workflow from protocol to communication.
Objectives, procedures, roles, budget, timeline and permissions.
Use a codebook, source checks, unique IDs and approved versions.
Correct variable types, missing-data rules, denominators and justified tests.
Check uncertainty, assumptions, deviations and alternative explanations.
Report findings, limitations, implications and governed retention.
Keep raw records and analysis decisions traceable under authorized access.
